state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. Every band through the
configuration band `E0601`–`E0650` carries cards, and so does the `E07xx` types band from `E0700`
through `E0762`. Every other code (`E0763` onward in `E07xx`, then `E08xx` and `E09xx`) is in the
test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201`
prints a code's card. Stage 5 is not started.

next.title: every diagnostic code carries its card

items.text: **Drain the list, one band slice per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the next slice starts at `E0763` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4120` and takes about 30 codes a session (through about `E0799`, the end of `E07xx`). The list at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:5141` is the order. A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above each code yourself with one Read over the slice, and send one `Explore` search for the raise sites (mostly under `crates/nvs-types/src/`), returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code, `(N sites)` where there are several, and `NOT RAISED` for a code nothing raises. Write every card as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0763");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form with `\` line continuations), plus one block deleting the slice's codes from the list (a block matches a substring, so `"E0763", "E0764",` alone is a valid OLD), then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow it. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone. Attribute syntax for an example comes from the corpus: `#[Core\Route(path: "/users", method: Core\Http\Method::Get)]`, `#[Core\Access(allow: Core\Audience::Public)]`.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:5159` once the list is empty: it asserts `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` is empty, and the list and its doc comment go with it.
